temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria notices Cheryl looking stressed and overwhelmed by stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project. Cheryl accepts Maria's offer of help, saying it would be amazing and she could use the help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria has no specific prior belief that Cheryl is overwhelmed by this project.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Maria learns Cheryl is stressed and would welcome assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl needs and appreciates help with the project.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern and empathy, followed by willingness and relief at being able to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To assist Cheryl with the community outreach project paperwork and planning.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping Cheryl, Maria observes Cheryl handling responsibilities better and growing in confidence. At the staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl lead the next phase, and Cheryl accepts and thanks Maria for her confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl has improved her ability to handle responsibilities and is gaining confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Maria's suggestion is well received by the team leader, and Cheryl accepts the leadership role while expressing gratitude for Maria's confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl is ready and willing to take on leadership, and that Cheryl values Maria's confidence in her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Cheryl in the leadership role and help the project succeed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria approaches Cheryl privately to check for hard feelings. Cheryl says she was a bit surprised but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria worries that Cheryl might perceive Maria's leadership suggestion as overstepping or pressure, and wants to avoid misunderstanding.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Cheryl reassures Maria that although she was surprised, she appreciates the support and belief.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl does not feel pressured or resentful; Cheryl values Maria's honesty and support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To ensure Cheryl feels supported and not pressured, and to maintain a positive relationship.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl responds positively to Maria's proposal that they co-lead the project, calling it a fantastic idea and saying Maria's guidance has been invaluable and they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria feels relieved that Cheryl valued her honesty and support, and believes their relationship is positive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Cheryl enthusiastically agrees to co-lead and affirms that Maria's guidance is valuable and they are a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes they can collaborate effectively as co-leaders and support each other.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To co-lead the project with Cheryl and continue supporting each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects, strengthening their partnership. When Maria asks about teaming up for future projects, Cheryl says she'd love that, calls working with Maria wonderful, and is excited about what they can achieve together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their collaboration has been fruitful and their partnership has strengthened through successful projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Cheryl confirms she wants to work together on future projects and values their partnership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes their partnership is strong and future collaboration is promising.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Cheryl for more projects in the future.
